title: 2025-05-14 Stage 2 Scene-Extraction Recheck
lede: Seven remaining judgment calls need a ruling after eight per-scene audits against the corrected upstream artifacts and cleaned VTT.
footer: Applied without asking during this recheck: 18 issue-level mechanical or source-provenance corrections across scene files 02–08. A concurrent staged_consistency_stage_2_review queue and decisions file were preserved unchanged and were not treated as authorization for this recheck.

items.t: [Minor] Treat ‘I drink tea’ as Gary’s table banter rather than confirmed Brewbarry canon.
items.y: In scene_extractions/01_character_introductions_and_backstories.md:424, relabel the cue as ‘Gary Young — table banter; intended PC uncertain.’ Brewbarry will no longer be credited with a tea-drinking preference from this cue alone.
items.n: Leave scene_extractions/01_character_introductions_and_backstories.md:424 labeled Brewbarry, retaining the current in-character interpretation.
items.ev: The cleaned VTT identifies only Gary Young at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:1853. Gary voiced both Brewbarry and Valphine during this session, and the surrounding exchange does not settle the intended PC.

items.t: [Moderate] Clarify that Brewbarry communicates with musical notes, not written notes.
items.y: Revise scene_extractions/02_a_new_beginning_setting_out_from_neverwinter.md:18 and :425 to say Brewbarry is jokingly described as communicating through musical notes. This removes the implication that he writes notes or cannot speak.
items.n: Leave both ‘with notes’ summaries unchanged, preserving the ambiguous written-note reading.
items.ev: The VTT follows UNKNOWN’s ‘With notes’ at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:3145 with Gary’s clarification ‘Love music with notes’ at :3153.

items.t: [Minor] Record Toblen’s ten-copper price without claiming Soma paid it.
items.y: At scene_extractions/04_arrival_at_the_stonehill_inn.md:12 and :509, change ‘charges’ to ‘asks’ or ‘quotes a price of.’ The recap will preserve the price while leaving payment unconfirmed.
items.n: Keep ‘charges,’ which can be read as saying the ten copper was actually paid.
items.ev: Toblen states the price at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:4065, but the transcript records no explicit coin transfer afterward.

items.t: [Minor] Reconstruct two UNKNOWN Goodberry-preparation lines as Soma.
items.y: At scene_extractions/06_the_journey_to_the_excavation.md:110 and :113, attribute ‘I could prepare Goodberries’ and the Longstrider replacement to Soma with an editorial note that the VTT speaker is UNKNOWN but the surrounding druid-spell exchange settles the role. Leave ‘Oh, good’ as UNKNOWN.
items.n: Keep both preparation lines as UNKNOWN, avoiding a contextual speaker reconstruction.
items.ev: The UNKNOWN cues occur at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:5261 and :5269, between Wade/Soma checking the druid list and saying Ice Knife would never be used at :5273. Both corrected upstream recaps describe Soma as considering the change.

items.t: [Moderate] Reconstruct ‘Yes, of course’ as Norbus accepting Vukradin’s rightful-owner condition.
items.y: At scene_extractions/07_meeting_the_prospectors.md:469, replace ‘David Mendenhall [?]’ with ‘Norbus Ironrune — role reconstructed; VTT says David Mendenhall [?].’ The dwarf, rather than Vukradin’s player, will be recorded as accepting the condition.
items.n: Keep the raw uncertain David Mendenhall attribution and do not infer which prospector answered.
items.ev: Vukradin asks the prospectors to return relics to their owners immediately before the uncertain cue at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:6997-7001; the reply is followed by Vukradin saying the party will consider the job.

items.t: [Moderate] Reconstruct ‘Well, yes’ as Valphine answering Norbus’s faith question.
items.y: At scene_extractions/07_meeting_the_prospectors.md:346, replace ‘Kostadis Roussos [?]’ with ‘Valphine Sotorra — role reconstructed; VTT says Kostadis Roussos [?].’ The answer will be attached to the drow cleric being questioned.
items.n: Keep the raw uncertain Kostadis attribution and avoid reconstructing Valphine’s reply.
items.ev: The GM asks ‘Are you really a cleric of Lathander?’ at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:6381; the uncertain ‘Well, yes’ follows immediately at :6385.

items.t: [Minor] Replace the uncertain GM label on ‘I’ve already made the day’s journey’ with UNKNOWN.
items.y: At scene_extractions/07_meeting_the_prospectors.md:520, change the label to ‘UNKNOWN — party-side comment; speaker unresolved.’ The line will no longer look like a confident GM statement.
items.n: Keep ‘Kostadis Roussos [?],’ preserving the diarizer’s best guess and its uncertainty marker.
items.ev: The cleaned VTT labels the cue Kostadis Roussos [?] at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:7077, but its first-person reasoning belongs to the party’s decision whether to continue.
